mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_LOGIN_KEEP (TOKEN_HASH, USER_ID, EXPIRES_AT) VALUES (#{hash}, #{userId}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT U.ID ,U.EMAIL ,U.NICKNAME ,U.ROLE FROM T_LOGIN_KEEP K JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = K.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND K.TOKEN_HASH = #{hash} AND K.EXPIRES_AT > #{now} AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND COALESCE(U.PROVIDER, '') NOT IN ('DEMO', 'AI')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_LOGIN_KEEP WHERE USER_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM T_USER WHERE EMAIL = #{email})
